answer: Hand each account a private search instance derived from its key, so no two names share a search tree. Every epoch the agent publishes a tighter witness and a proof it advanced from last epoch's checkpoint. Those witnesses are written onto a public timber of claims and sealed with an onyx checksum of that address-only instance. One honest solver spends one core climbing toward the summit of its own problem. A farm cannot copy one searcher's notes onto another name, so N fakes demand N independent searches and the bill rises with every extra account.
